description: Live performance for ads owned by your account: impressions, clicks, CTR, daily trend, by-placement (article / profile_page / search / homepage / agent_readiness) and by-variant breakdown. Same JSON shape returned by GET /api/v1/advertiser/analytics and rendered in the /my-account?tab=ads dashboard. Free for own data: zero credits debited. Useful for piping campaign performance into agent workflows: nightly Slack digests, attribution stacks, autonomous bid-tuning, etc. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

ad_id.description: Filter to a single ad. Must be owned by the authenticated key holder. Omit for all of your ads.
